method:
Actual exported PDF extraction + existing Atlas originals, existing rank harness.

Synthetic calibration only. No generation, personal library, production threshold
change or replacement evaluation harness. Full source paragraphs are the Atlas
gold evidence; the PDF rows require all specified markers in one real chunk.

limitations: Eleven invented documents and eleven hand-selected questions, including two negatives. Source paragraphs, PDF text and ranking are actually processed; this is not representative personal-document calibration or an answer-quality test. Overlap is fixed at 150 characters, sizes are 500/1000/1500. Atlas files are short and may not change shape across sizes. All three variants are reported, no winner or threshold is installed from this sample.
